en: An old monochrome postcard showing a large Renaissance-style building with a steep roof, dormer windows and an ornate central gable. A double exterior staircase leads up to a doorway above an arched entrance. People, including men in hats and children, stand in the open square in front. At the bottom and left of the card is printed and handwritten text in Dutch; the red printed title in the center reads "Waag, Nijmegen".
